code_review.initial_fleet_and_pipeline: original efficiency retained; original nonpower residual identification unchanged
code_review.mixing: exposure-weighted harmonic efficiency; physical stock separately used in snapshots
code_review.future_planning: known projects and survival only, no future realised decisions or fuel prices
code_review.learning: candidate heat saving relative to current mixed fleet, avoids repeating initial-vs-new saving; ETS marginal fuel term included
code_review.projects: approval-year tagging, commissioning copies persisted value to cohort
code_review.screening: separate real LP candidate contribution, then joint renewable/thermal rescreen; bounded failure/removal
code_review.cash: operating LP mixed efficiency matches inherited fuel bill/ETS and independent per-cohort fuel/carbon ledger

remaining_limits: Shared utilisation within each technology is not unit-level merit order; efficient-new and inefficient-old plants cannot dispatch separately
2015 availability and 2025 technical costs remain conditional assumptions, not observed historical vintage data
2014 fleet own-use ratios remain proxies for converting net technical efficiency to gross
Aggregate annual exposure cannot model seasonal commissioning or part-load heat rates
Fuel-price and efficiency sensitivities do not resolve national historical model acceptance
